name: Empty Room, Full Story
why_it_works: An empty room is hard to love because buyers cannot picture living in it. Showing the bare space first, then the finished room, lets the viewer feel the jump from 'just walls' to 'my life here', and that feeling is what makes them book a showing.

hook.pattern: Open on the barest, least flattering room and ask whether the viewer would walk past it.
examples: Would you have walked past this room?
Same {{property_type}}. Same square feet. Watch it change.
Empty rooms don't sell. Here's what we do instead.

craft.notes: Shoot or generate the empty and staged versions from the exact same corner and height so the change reads instantly. Lead with the worst room, not the best; the bigger the gap, the stronger the reveal.

do_not: Show AI or virtual staging without labeling it as staged
Alter permanent features (windows, views, room size, condition) in any image
Describe who the home is 'perfect for' by family status, religion, age or any protected class
compliance: Real estate: label every virtually staged image 'Virtually staged'; never change walls, flooring, views or defects
Real estate: include brokerage name and agent license number per state advertising rules; follow Fair Housing Act wording
Mortgage: do not show rates or payments without APR and required disclosures; include NMLS number
Short-term rental: photos must match what guests will actually get
